UAS Pilot and Operations Specialist

Job Description

Oxy is seeking an experienced UAS Pilot and Operations Specialist to support inspection and asset integrity activities across Oxy’s offshore operations. The position will primarily conduct unmanned aircraft system (UAS) inspections of offshore production facilities and associated infrastructure, providing high-quality visual and sensor data to Mechanical Integrity, Corrosion, Facilities Engineering, Operations and Maintenance teams.

The successful candidate will combine strong UAS flight skills with a safety-focused field mindset and the ability to recognize, document and communicate potential equipment and structural integrity concerns. This position will work closely with offshore operations and technical teams to expand the use of UAS technology for safer, more efficient and more comprehensive inspection of difficult-to-access equipment and structures.

Roles and Responsibilities

• Safely plan and execute UAS inspection missions on offshore production facilities, with primary emphasis on mechanical integrity and asset integrity applications.
• Conduct detailed visual inspections of piping, pressure equipment, structural members, flare systems, risers, piping supports, decks, cranes, tanks, vessels and other offshore infrastructure.
• Capture high-resolution imagery, video and other sensor data necessary to support mechanical integrity, corrosion and engineering assessments.
• Identify and document observable conditions including corrosion, coating degradation, structural deterioration, damaged insulation, leaks, loose or missing components and other potential integrity concerns.
• Coordinate inspection activities with Mechanical Integrity, Corrosion, Facilities Engineering, Operations, Maintenance and HSE personnel.
• Develop flight and inspection plans based on inspection scope, equipment configuration, operating conditions, airspace restrictions and offshore hazards.
• Conduct pre-flight risk assessments and participate in applicable offshore permitting, Job Safety Analysis and simultaneous operations planning.
• Maintain strict compliance with Oxy HSE requirements, offshore operating procedures, FAA regulations and internal UAS policies and standards.
• Evaluate environmental and operational conditions—including wind, weather, electromagnetic interference, obstacles and active process equipment—to determine whether UAS operations can be conducted safely.
• Maintain UAS aircraft, batteries, payloads, cameras and supporting equipment in mission-ready condition.
• Manage inspection imagery and associated data to ensure appropriate quality, traceability, organization and transfer to engineering and inspection personnel.
• Assist technical teams in developing standardized UAS inspection procedures, image-capture requirements and repeatable inspection routes.
• Support periodic and repeat inspections that allow engineering teams to monitor equipment condition and degradation over time.
• Work with inspection and engineering personnel to integrate UAS-generated information into existing mechanical integrity and risk-based inspection programs.
• Support the evaluation and deployment of emerging UAS technologies, including advanced imaging, thermal sensors, photogrammetry, automated flight planning, remote inspection technologies and AI-enabled image analysis.
• Identify opportunities where UAS inspections can reduce personnel exposure, scaffolding, rope access, vessel support or other conventional inspection requirements while maintaining appropriate inspection quality.
• Prepare clear inspection documentation and communicate significant observations promptly to appropriate offshore and technical personnel.
• Maintain required flight logs, aircraft records, maintenance records, certifications and other regulatory documentation.
• Support UAS operations at onshore facilities or other Oxy assets as business needs require.
• Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications

Required

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate.
• Demonstrated experience operating UAS in industrial, energy, infrastructure, construction, inspection or similar environments.
• Strong understanding of safe UAS flight planning, aircraft limitations, weather considerations and operational risk management.
• Ability to work safely in an offshore oil and gas operating environment.
• Ability to recognize and accurately document equipment and structural conditions using visual inspection techniques.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data and inspection quality.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively with operations personnel, inspectors, engineers and technical specialists.
• Ability and willingness to travel offshore and work non-routine schedules as required.
• Ability to obtain and maintain required offshore safety training and certifications.
• Valid driver’s license and ability to meet applicable company requirements for offshore travel.

Preferred

• 3+ years of UAS flight experience, including industrial inspection applications.
• Experience conducting UAS inspections on offshore platforms, oil and gas facilities, petrochemical facilities, pipelines or other complex industrial assets.
• Experience supporting mechanical integrity, corrosion, nondestructive examination (NDE/NDT), structural inspection or facilities maintenance programs.
• Familiarity with offshore production equipment, piping systems, pressure vessels, flare systems, structural components and corrosion mechanisms.
• Experience with thermal imaging, high-resolution optical inspection, photogrammetry, 3D modeling or other advanced UAS payloads.
• Experience operating UAS in challenging environments involving structures, confined operating areas, high winds or complex industrial hazards.
• Knowledge of API, ASME or other applicable mechanical integrity and inspection standards.
• NDT certification, API inspection certification or related inspection training is a plus.
• Experience with UAS data-management, inspection-management or image-analysis software.
• Experience developing UAS procedures, inspection workflows or standardized flight plans.

Skills and Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

• A strong commitment to safety and operational discipline.
• Personal accountability and sound judgment in field operations.
• Technical curiosity and an interest in applying new technology to solve operational problems.
• Strong observational and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining close coordination with offshore operations and technical teams.
• Ability to recognize when conditions require stopping or modifying a planned UAS operation.
• High standards for inspection quality, documentation and data management.
• Initiative and a continuous-improvement mindset.
• Ability to communicate technical observations clearly and objectively.

Working Conditions

This position requires frequent travel to offshore production facilities in the Gulf of Mexico. Work may involve transportation by helicopter or marine vessel, extended offshore workdays, exposure to heat, humidity, wind and other environmental conditions, and operation around active industrial equipment.

The position requires the ability to carry and operate UAS equipment, work outdoors for extended periods and perform duties while wearing required personal protective equipment.

The UAS Pilot is expected to exercise independent stop-work authority when flight, weather, equipment or operating conditions do not support safe execution of the planned mission.

• Complete other assigned projects and responsibilities.

• Associate's or Bachelor’s degree in business administration, operations, manufacturing, or a related field is preferred.

• 1+ year of experience directly managing salaried employees.

회사소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.
분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요..
팀 소개
